text:
Maria: quick heads-up: saw duplicate page fetches from the web sample when auth refresh is slow. Two requests for `?cursor=abc` fired ~20ms apart, server returned 429 on the second.
Jordan: is that from the prefetcher?
Maria: yes, prefetch + user scroll -> simultaneous calls. Then token refresh path retries the original request once auth returns.
Sam: which SDK? JS? version?
Maria: js-sample-app using @redwood/sdk v2.1.4. Repro: open feed, scroll fast, force token to expire (devauth toggle).
Jordan: hmm, looks like the prefetcher doesn't dedupe in-flight identical GETs. Also the auth retry blindly replays. Two separate mechanisms colliding.
Liam: can you paste the minimal stack snippet?
Maria: pasted snippet: `prefetcher.fetchPage -> Balancer.request -> auth.refreshIfNeeded -> request()` then `auth.refresh` resolves, and the original caller re-invokes request while prefetcher already fired a second call.
Sam: simple workaround for sample-app: singleflight map keyed by path+cursor. JS example: ```js
const inflight = new Map();
function dedupe(key, fn) {
  if (inflight.has(key)) return inflight.get(key);
  const p = fn().finally(() => inflight.delete(key));
  inflight.set(key, p);
  return p;
}
```
Maria: validated locally: 100 rapid scroll events + 1s token latency -> without dedupe 18% 429s, with dedupe 0.
Jordan: should this live in the SDK or sample-app? SDK parity: python/go don't prefetch by default, so adding JS-only dedupe might be unexpected.
Sam: we could add it as an opt-in config: `clientOptions: { dedupeInFlight: boolean }`. Default false to avoid surprising behavior. Sample-app can enable.
Liam: infra thought: server could honor an `Idempotency-Key` for GETs too, or return a custom header allowing cheap dedupe, but that's a bigger change.
Maria: agreed server-side change is heavier. For now I prefer SDK opt-in + docs about auth interplay. Also add jittered retry for prefetch to spread load when auth is slow.
Jordan: tests required: concurrent callers, token refresh race, memory leak check when many unique cursors. Add unit tests mocking auth.
Sam: I'll draft SDK PR with flag and test harness. Also add an example in sample-app showing turning prefetch off.
Maria: filed sample-app PR (link removed) and attached a repro recording.
devex-bot: created DEVEX-6001: "js-sdk: add dedupeInFlight option + doc on prefetch+auth race" and assigned @Sam.
Liam: ops-bot, heads-up: we saw a small spike in 429s in staging around the time of the stress test yesterday.
ops-bot: noticed incident? staging-429-surge logged at 2024-07-11T15:42:00Z, alerted to infra.
Maria: once Sam's PR lands, can we enable dedupe in the sample-app dev build and run the stress suite?
Sam: yup. I'll do that and post results. ETA EOD today.
Jordan: follow-up item: audit other client sample apps (mobile/desktop) for same pattern.
Maria: adding to onboarding notes: "If your client does prefetching, consider dedupeInFlight or disable prefetch during auth refresh."
Sam: thanks all. I'll ping when PR is up. :coffee:
